root.label: Eiffel Tower reopens after staff protest

events.label: Eiffel Tower reopens after staff protest

slots.name: tower status
slots.sentence: On its website, the Eiffel Tower said the iconic monument was “open today”.

slots.name: reopening date
slots.sentence: It said the landmark would reopen on Tuesday following a meeting the previous day between staff and management over the incident, which has also drawn criticism from French politicians.

slots.name: reopening time
slots.sentence: Shortly before 9:30am (7:30 GMT), visitors were passing through security checkpoints at the foot of the tower, a journalist with the AFP news agency said.
